title: Indra OCR 1.1 Rivals 3.4B Param DeepSeek Performance With 1M Parameters
summary:
Vik Paruchuri expanded the capabilities of his latest optical character recognition tool to include handwriting and support for dozens of languages. The recently released Indra OCR 1.1 utilizes a 1M parameter model to process 44 pages per second on a CPU and scores within 4 points of the 3.4B parameter DeepSeek OCR 2 on the OmniParseBench benchmark. It also outperforms the 1.1B parameter HunyuanOCR with a score of 66.7 against 64.6, and includes a --math flag that uses a 12M parameter model to improve mathematical text processing.

The original version of Indra, launched Oct 13, processed 49 pages per second and surpassed PaddleOCR and Tesseract in throughput. The version 1.1 update supports over 80 languages and maintains a speed that is 15x faster than Tesseract on CPU hardware while narrowing the accuracy gap between compact models and larger architectures.
